items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Binnen zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung dieses Bescheids kann Einspruch eingelegt werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Beispielborken – Bußgeldstelle.
items.computation: The letter was formally served (förmliche Zustellung, § 182 ZPO, Zustellungsurkunde on page 2), not merely posted, so the statutory deemed-delivery fiction for ordinary post (3/4 days) does not apply; the actual service date controls. The Zustellungsurkunde shows delivery on Tuesday 24.11.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the two-week objection period starts 25.11.2026. Two weeks later, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, is Tuesday 08.12.2026, which is a working day in NRW (no Saturday/Sunday/public-holiday shift needed).

items.title: Pay the total fine (Gesamtbetrag) once the decision is final
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Gesamtbetrag erst nach Rechtskraft, und zwar innerhalb von zwei Wochen.
items.computation: The letter instructs payment only after Rechtskraft (legal finality), which occurs if no Einspruch is filed within the two-week objection period ending 08.12.2026; Rechtskraft then sets in on 09.12.2026, the day after that period expires. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day Rechtskraft occurs is not counted, so the two-week payment period starts 10.12.2026; two weeks later, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, is Wednesday 23.12.2026, a working day in NRW, so no shift is needed. This date only applies if no Einspruch is filed; an objection suspends both Rechtskraft and the duty to pay.

items.title: Optional information session (Sprechstunde) about speeding offences
items.quote: Wer mehr über das Thema erfahren möchte, kann am 11.12.2026 unsere offene Sprechstunde im Bürgerhaus Ostweide besuchen; die Teilnahme ist freiwillig und kostenlos.
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date for this voluntary event: 11.12.2026. It explicitly states participation is voluntary and free, so it is not an obligation, only an offered appointment.

warnings: The Einspruch deadline (and, derived from it, the payment deadline) depends on the hand-filled delivery date on the Zustellungsurkunde (page 2, '24.11.2026'); double-check that this handwritten date is correctly legible and accurate, since both deadlines are computed from it.
The payment deadline of 23.12.2026 applies only if no Einspruch is filed by 08.12.2026; filing an objection suspends both the Rechtskraft (legal finality) and the duty to pay the 132,00 € total.

The sender's printed email address ends in the placeholder domain '.example' (bussgeld@kreis-beispielborken-bußgeld.example), which is not a real, deliverable address — confirm the authority's genuine contact and payment details via an independent source before paying or replying, and do not rely on contact details from the letter alone if anything about it seems off.
